preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 3000 and 1 <= m <= n for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of nesting places n and the number of villages m satisfy 1 <= m <= n <= 3000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_i <= 10**9 for test_case in test_cases for b_i in test_case['b'])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of bees b_i in each nesting place is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= w_i <= 10**9 for test_case in test_cases for w_i in test_case['w'])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of wasps w_i in each nesting place is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(test_case['adjacencies']) == n - 1 for test_case in test_cases for n in [test_case['n']])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of adjacencies is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in test_case['adjacencies']) for test_case in test_cases for n in [test_case['n']])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each adjacency pair (x, y) consists of distinct integers between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result <= n for result, n in zip(results, [test_case['n'] for test_case in test_cases]))
postconditions.description: The result for each test case is the maximum number of villages in which Ugly Wasp wins, and it is between 0 and n inclusive.
